summary.text: Two mechanics argue over an engine in a cramped garage.

description.text: The cramped garage presses in around a dark green car pushed between dented metal shelving and a workbench crowded with jars, wrenches, and coiled hose. A single caged work lamp hangs low, throwing a warm pool of light over the open engine bay while the rest of the room stays in deep shadow. The older mechanic leans across the radiator support, close-cropped gray hair catching the lamp, his weathered face narrowed in concentration. One hand grips a gray shop rag, and he jabs a rag-wrapped finger toward a frayed drive belt at the front of the engine. Oil darkens the knuckles of his navy coveralls, and the belt's worn ribs show where the rubber has started to split. He keeps his eyes on the engine, jaw set, and delivers his short line in a flat mutter without looking up. The younger mechanic waits as a dim shape on the far side of the bay.
Dust hangs in the lamp's warm cone; the open hood fills the center of the bay.
The older mechanic drags the rag across the radiator support.
The rag rasps over metal; the engine ticks unevenly.
He taps the split ribs of the belt and mutters.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

The younger mechanic straightens on the far side of the engine bay, his lean frame rising out of the shadow behind the open hood. He wears a dark work shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, and a thin streak of grease crosses one forearm. He wipes both hands slowly on a bunched shop rag, then lifts his chin and fixes the older man with a steady stare. The caged lamp catches the sweat at his temple and the hard line of his mouth as he answers with his fixed line, refusing the older mechanic's diagnosis. Between them, the engine idles with a low, uneven tick, and the frayed belt trembles at the front of the block. A tool rests near the edge of the bench, and the cluttered shelves close the space in on both men. The older mechanic stays bent over the bay, rag still in hand, while the younger man holds his ground.
The younger mechanic rises into the lamp light with the bunched rag.
He wipes his palms and meets the older man's stare.
Cloth drags; the idle drops; a tool clicks on the bench.
The camera holds a static shot.
